{"code": "import pandas as pd

data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the two flagged issues
print('Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline:', (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())
print('Number of duplicate patient_id:', data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check if any patient_id appears more than once
patient_counts = data['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]
print('\nPatients with multiple entries:', duplicates.index.tolist())
print('Max sample_seq per patient:', data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().max())"}
